claim: R5-08 (c) gave a famine look a `field` read. V09 wrote its test into T-V9-85 (V09 l. 4436): "on a dossier crisis fixture with a famine at severity 0.5 (V08 §7.1), the why card of a bare field carries `info.crisis.ruinedFor` and that of a field left sown none". V08 §7.1's crisis fixtures (V08 l. 3242–3246) hold "… a famine, a fire, a flood and an earthquake … each standing through part of the year at its severity". They name no severity for the famine, and V12 §3.15.12 (l. 2693) and X-V12-5 restate them the same way. The clause needs a severity below 1, since at 1 every field is bare. V09's hand-off to V08 and V12 (repair-r5-V09 l. 120–122) is open. V12 declined it as V08's ("the severity belongs in V08 §7.1, which X-V12-5 then cites"). This is a fixture list that omits a case its test names, so the grade is minor (R5-01).
required_change: V08 §7.1's crisis fixtures (l. 3244): "a plague with its affected quarter, a famine, a fire" → "a plague with its affected quarter, a famine at severity 0.5 (its look baring part of the arable faces and leaving the rest sown, V09's T-V9-85), a fire".

claim: R5-03 holds a late calamity carried by an absorb whose week is not after `W₀` "for the first epoch a later absorb folds" (base §4.11 *The clock* (4) l. 8483; V08 §3.6 (3) l. 1871–1876; §7.7's comment l. 11825). V08 §3.6 (4) (l. 1903–1908) writes the whole held list in every `dossierFacts` event ("the binding's list less each calamity the first epoch this absorb folds carries, plus each late calamity this absorb holds"). So a later absorb past `W₀` that folds no epoch must write the list unchanged and fold no epoch for the held calamity, unlike a newly carried late one with `W₁` after `W₀`, for which "the port folds one at `W₁`". The calamity waits up to the next year end. That is the common path: weekly syncs between year ends fold none. T-V8-49 (g) (V08 l. 3311) and T76-1 (base l. 18242–18245) hold the calamity and then make the very next absorb fold an epoch (a population move past the tolerance). So two wrong builds pass every bar, T-V8-5's fold check included. One writes `lateCalamities` from this absorb's new holds alone, so the list empties at a no-epoch absorb and the calamity is silently lost. The other folds an epoch at `W₁` for a held calamity. VV78-r5-01 names this wait but tests only a forked copy.
required_change: T-V8-49 (g), after "the next absorb past `W₀` folding the crossing and the calamity's strike at its first epoch's first week, its deaths in that epoch's burial need", add: "; and on a copy, between the hold and that absorb, an absorb past `W₀` with no year end, no crossing and no calamity (one institution's `state` changed) — no epoch folded, its `dossierFacts` event listing the held calamity in `lateCalamities`, the calamity not struck — then an absorb past the next year end folding the year-end epoch, the calamity riding it at its first week `W₀` + 1, struck once, its deaths in that epoch's burial need, `lateCalamities` empty after".

claim: R5-03 adds `DossierBinding.lateCalamities: string[]`, "the binding keys of late calamities held" (§7.7 l. 11825). A held calamity's `CalamityRef` is built "from its carried `calamity` fact under the held key" (V08 §3.6 (3) l. 1894–1895). The calamity key is a port-minted binding key (`calamity:<week>:<slug(name)>`, V08 §2.3). At a line change, "B's `fromLines` entry for A re-keys the binding rows (a `rebind` `setAttr` per changed key …)", and an entry may be a `table` of `{ from, to }` rows (V08 §2.4 l. 587; §3.8 l. 2042–2047; §2.3's row life l. 566). Nothing re-keys `lateCalamities`, nor `quarantined[].key`, which has the same gap. Where the migrating or a later absorb folds the epoch the held calamity rides, a builder who re-keys rows and carried facts alone looks up the old key and finds no fact. The result is a crash, or the calamity silently lost against R5-03's "never lost". A quarantined record's stale key likewise stops shielding it from the diff. Two builders differ, and the case is not in the canon's catalogue (no migration entry for V08 §3.8's binding lists). T-V8-11 (l. 3273) runs only `identity` and the missing-entry hold.

claim: VV78-r4-04's fix widened §4.6's `late` variant to "a change carried at or before the last epoch's week (V08 §3.6 (3), (6))", and R5-03's T-V8-49 (g) notes the held calamity with it. Its words, "{name} is dated before the map's last update, so the map shows it as already finished.", are true of a non-calamity late change (applied finished) but false of a late calamity, which since R5-03 is never shown finished: it strikes at the first week after the last epoch, now (`W₁` after `W₀`) or held for a later epoch. §3.6 (3) also does not say that a late calamity in an absorb whose week is after `W₀` is noted, while §4.6's trigger includes it and the note's class `event` puts it in the log. The fix is a string and its trigger; nothing else built changes.
